requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The U-M bachelor's minimum. Prerequisite coursework plus the fixed six-semester professional curriculum typically exceeds it.

requirements.label: Prerequisite credit hours (35)
requirements.hint: A minimum of 35 credit hours of prerequisite coursework must be completed before applying. Applicants enter the program as sophomores; admission weighs science coursework heavily (incoming average GPA is about 3.5).

requirements.label: English composition
requirements.hint: One English composition course; at U-M, a course fulfilling the First-Year Writing Requirement. English Composition II is a suggested elective.

requirements.label: General chemistry with lab
requirements.hint: General chemistry lecture plus a lab; at U-M, CHEM 130 with CHEM 125 or 126.

requirements.label: Introductory sociology
requirements.hint: SOC 100 or an introductory special-topics section (SOC 102).

requirements.label: Speech (public speaking)
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule: U-M Ann Arbor does not offer a fundamentals-of-speech or public-speaking course, so this prerequisite is usually completed at a community college or another institution. Mark it done with the adjust control.

requirements.label: Anatomy & Physiology I & II or equivalent
requirements.hint: At U-M, one human anatomy course (ANATOMY 303 or 403) plus one human physiology course (PHYSIOL 201 or 502) is the standard equivalent.

requirements.label: Microbiology with lab
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 207 (lecture with lab), or MICRBIOL 405 paired with the MICRBIOL 350 lab.

requirements.label: Biochemistry
requirements.hint: One biochemistry course: BIOLCHEM 212 (Descriptive Biochemistry) is the common choice; BIOLCHEM 415, MCDB 310, or CHEM 351 also satisfy it.

requirements.label: Dental hygiene professional curriculum
requirements.hint: Still building automatic checking for this rule: after admission, the program is a fixed six-consecutive-semester cohort curriculum beginning in spring term, with no course selection to plan. Mark it done with the adjust control as you progress; dental hygiene courses are not yet in the course catalog.
